rows.text: returns 0 when dword `rcx+0x18` is -1; otherwise calls (`003E6AF0` + 0x11) with dword `rcx+0x10`, then (`003E6AF0` + 0x24) with qword `+0xD98` of the returned object and the `+0x18` value in `edx`, then (`003E6AF0` + 0x31) with that result, returning 0 when either of the last two returns null, and otherwise tail-jumps (`003E6AF0` + 0x43) with the final result in `rcx`

notes: 003E6AF0: all four callees cited by site since the host excerpt names none of them. The second `cmp ebx, -1` at 003E6B06 repeats the first test and can never take its branch. The result of the +0x11 call is not null-tested before qword +0xD98 is read.
